name: check_availability
description: Returns up to 3 free first-consultation slots, each with an ISO start and a Spanish label to say aloud. Call it when the History stage is saved as completed and the caller is ready to pick a time, and again if the caller asks for another day or another part of the day. Only offer slots this tool returned; never invent or adjust a time. If it returns no slots, say so and ask for a different day or part of the day. The response has a message field that says what to do next; follow it.

preferred_date.description: The day the caller prefers, as YYYY-MM-DD. Convert what the caller says using today's date. Omit it if the caller has no preference. Example: 2026-10-12.

part_of_day.description: morning or afternoon if the caller expressed a preference. Omit it otherwise.
